title: Limoneira CO 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: Limoneira Company (LMNR) filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026 disclosing the sale of an 80% tenant-in-common interest in its Paso Robles real estate to Peak Holdings, LLC for $16 million ($10 million cash, $6 million promissory note). The company expects to record an impairment of approximately $9.3 million in Q2 fiscal year 2026 as a result of the transaction. The deal is subject to a due diligence period expiring July 1, 2026.
key_points: Limoneira subsidiary Windfall Investors entered into a Purchase and Sale Agreement dated April 14, 2026 with Peak Holdings, LLC.
Buyer is acquiring an 80% undivided tenant-in-common interest in 724 acres of Paso Robles land plus improvements including grape vines and infrastructure.
Total purchase price is $16,000,000: $10,000,000 cash at closing plus $6,000,000 via promissory note secured by deed of trust.
Buyer deposited $500,000 as a refundable down payment into escrow, which becomes non-refundable after July 1, 2026 due diligence period.
The company expects to recognize an impairment of approximately $9,300,000 to property, plant and equipment in Q2 fiscal year 2026.
The transaction includes assignment of associated licenses, permits, development approvals, mineral rights, development rights, and air rights.
